description: Put a bottle on your wishlist: a new one (expression_path or name), or move an existing bottle_id there. Two steps: the first call only previews and returns confirm_token; show the preview to the user and repeat the call with confirm_token only after they agree.

confirm_token.description: Omit on the first call to get a preview. After the user agrees, call again with identical arguments plus this token.

name.description: Bottle name when it isn't in the catalog

name: wishlist_add
